[s0l0!-header][h1]Logical Operators[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

Logical operators can be used to combine two Boolean values and return a result of  [b]true[/b], [b]false[/b], or [b]null[/b].
[s0l0!-header][b]The following operators can be used:[/b][/s0l0!-header] [img id="2809" width="100%"]
When retrieving data using a SELECT statement, use logical operators in the WHERE clause to combine multiple conditions.

If you want to select rows that satisfy all of the given conditions, use the logical operator, [b]AND[/b].  [img id="2810" width="100%"]
To find the names of the customers between 30 to 40 years of age, set up the query as seen here:[code format="sql" codeId="3044"]SELECT ID, FirstName, LastName, Age
FROM customers
WHERE Age >= 30 [b]AND[/b] Age <= 40;[/code]
[s0l0!-header][b]This results in the following output:[/b][/s0l0!-header] [img id="2811" width="100%"]
[note]You can combine as many conditions as needed to return the desired results.[/note]

content.text:
逻辑运算符可用于组合两个布尔值，并返回**true**(真)、**false**(假)或**null**(空)的结果。

**可以使用以下运算符：**：

|运算符|功能|
|-|-|
|`AND`|与运算，表达式均为true，则为true，否则false|
|`OR`|或运算，表达式均为false，则为false，否则true|
|`IN`|如果操作数等于表达式列表中的一个，则为true|
|`NOT`|取反，表达式为true，则为false，否则true|

content.text:
当使用SELECT语句检索数据时，可在WHERE子句中使用逻辑运算符组合多个条件。

如果你想选择满足所有给定条件的记录，请使用逻辑运算符**AND**。
content.text_html:
When retrieving data using a SELECT statement, use logical operators in the WHERE clause to combine multiple conditions.

If you want to select rows that satisfy all of the given conditions, use the logical operator, AND.

如果你想选择满足所有给定条件的记录，请使用逻辑运算符AND。

content.name: 电影查询
content.description: 编写一个查询来输出某个制片方的所有电影的名字。
content.title: and 查询

resolved.title: 漫威电影查询
resolved.problem_statement_md:
假设有一张电影表**films**，其中每部电影的详细信息：

![](/content/assets/066bfb0727e2f50ef761.jpeg)

其中列字段含义为：
- `name`: 电影名
- `genre`: 电影风格
- `year`: 发行年
- `production`: 制片方


请编写一个查询，输出制片方**Marvel Studios**在2010年或以后制作的所有电影的名称，并按名称排序。
resolved.problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Logical Operators[/h1][/s0l0!-header]

You are given the following [b]films[/b] table with details about superhero movies: [img id="4514" width="100%"]
Write a query to output the [b]names[/b] of all of the films which were produced by Marvel Studios in 2010 or later, sorted by the 'name' column.
[note]Use the [b]AND[/b] operator to combine two or more conditions.[/note]
resolved.hint_md: 使用**AND**操作符来组合两个或多个条件。

code_templates.solution_code:
SELECT name 
FROM films 
WHERE production = 'Marvel Studios' AND year >= 2010 
ORDER BY name
code_templates.prepend_code:
CREATE TABLE films (
  name VARCHAR(128),
  genre VARCHAR(128),
  year int,
  production VARCHAR(128)
);

INSERT INTO films (name,genre,year,production)
VALUES
('Iron Man','Superheroes',2008,'Marvel Studios'),
('Venom','Superheroes',2018,'Columbia Pictures'),
('The Dark Knight','Superheroes',2008,'Warner Brothers'),
('The Avengers','Superheroes',2012,'Marvel Studios'),
('Avengers:Endgame','Superheroes',2019,'Marvel Studios');

resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Combining AND & OR[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

The SQL [b]AND [/b]and [b]OR [/b]conditions may be combined to test multiple conditions in a query. 
These two operators are called [b]conjunctive operators[/b].

When combining these conditions, it is important to use [b]parentheses[/b], so that the order to evaluate each condition is known.

[s0l0!-header][b]Consider the following table:[/b][/s0l0!-header] [img id="2814" width="100%"]
The statement below selects all customers from the city "New York" [b]AND [/b]with the age equal to "30" [b]OR [/b]“35":[code format="sql" codeId="3046"]SELECT * FROM customers
WHERE City = 'New York'
[b]AND [/b](Age=30[b] OR[/b] Age=35);[/code]
[s0l0!-header][b]Result:[/b][/s0l0!-header] [img id="2815" width="100%"]
[note]You can nest as many conditions as you need.[/note]
